hackathon.name: Mind the Product presents World Product Day: Everyone Ships Now

delivery_mode_reason: Online Devpost submissions use a hosted demo video URL and no separate mandatory deck slot; the combined pitch plus demo video is the judging artifact.

frontend.dependency_policy: frontend deps install with @latest or unversioned targets unless a verified override is recorded
frontend.non_tailwind_visual_signature: boxing-ring screen, click crosshair, KO stamp, replay filmstrip, rematch route ribbon
frontend.hero_composition: product ring plus KO card plus rematch route ribbon
frontend.visual_differentiation_note: A playable first-click fight replaces the generic AI gradient, chat panel, dashboard, or checklist.

qr_mobile_access.mobile_primary_flow: scan QR, tap one product target, inspect card
qr_mobile_access.desktop_parity_plan: desktop keeps arena, card, route ribbon, and keyboard shortcuts visible

cutout_assets.command: node hackathonhunter/scripts/cutout_assets.mjs public/art/raw --out public/art/cutouts --brief-dir docs/ui-mockups/prompts --usage app-shell --auto-key --trim

domain.name: product-workflow
domain.professional_context: PM-builder first-run clarity, stranger first action, shipped rematch

deploy.last_smoke: Live hero loop: create fight -> separate-session first click (CTA_DEFENDED) -> KO card 200 -> GET /api/usage shows 2 D1 usage_events from 2 distinct sessions. Visual QA scan 0 errors / 0 warnings desktop+mobile.

required_env.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_NOVUS_APP_ID
required_env.required_for: Optional Novus tag once the Novus workspace is connected; the app ships the first-party usage loop without it
required_env.status: not-required for the hero path; deferred to Novus connect (G7)

required_env.name: OWNER_KEY_SECRET
required_env.storage: .dev.vars locally and Wrangler secret for deploy
required_env.status: configured (.dev.vars set locally; wrangler secret at deploy)

required_env.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL
required_env.required_for: card share links and QR routes

required_env.name: DB
required_env.required_for: D1 fights, clicks, cards, and usage events
required_env.status: configured (wrangler D1 binding DB; local migrated, remote provisioned)

real_data_sources.source: Cloudflare D1 tables fights, clicks, cards, usage_events
real_data_sources.evidence: D1 row ids surfaced in card/replay and Playwright trace

real_data_sources.source: Cloudflare D1 usage_events table written by recordUsageEvent and aggregated by buildUsageSummary
real_data_sources.evidence: GET /api/usage rows (fcf_fight_created, fcf_first_action_clicked, fcf_result_inspected, fcf_rematch_shipped) and the learning line that decides the rematch route

sponsor_technology.name: Novus by Pendo (usage-learning)
sponsor_technology.primitive: product-usage observation that informs what ships next
sponsor_technology.reviewer_visible_use: Every action is recorded in a first-party D1 usage_events loop that is the inspectable proof now, and the repo is structured for Novus to connect over GitHub and open its instrumentation PR before final submission.
sponsor_technology.proof: D1 usage_events rows via GET /api/usage, buildUsageSummary recommendation, .hunter/runtime-interaction.report.json, and Novus connect steps documented in SUBMISSION.md
sponsor_technology.depth: core mechanism: recorded usage decides the rematch route

product_backbone.identity: guest cookie plus signed owner key
product_backbone.multi_user_proof: incognito or phone creates first click, owner browser ships rematch, second visitor route changes

user_case_beats.beat: Builder marks intended CTA and creates fight
user_case_beats.state_change: D1 fights row changes from draft to live

user_case_beats.beat: Judge clicks where they would start
user_case_beats.state_change: D1 clicks row and card slug created

user_case_beats.beat: Owner ships rematch and second visitor route changes

operability.public_access: guest access; judge routes have no auth wall
operability.reset_or_seed_strategy: seed screens idempotently upsert into D1 and reset only demo rows
operability.abuse_limits: 20 click attempts per session per hour; first official click per fight per session

prd_coverage.minimum: every P0/P1 REQ row has route, API, real data, test, and deploy evidence before recording
